title: Officer not responsible for man's death despite Taser
article: There is no basis for charging the officer who used a Taser in subduing a former Canadian boxing champion who died, a SIU report says.

The three-page report released Monday by the province's Special Investigations Unit concluded Jerry Knight, 29, died from "restraint asphyxia with cocaine related excited delirium" rather than a Peel region officer's pepper spray and Taser blast.
